{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|They draw fibers from tree to tree, from bush to bush. They come in waves that overtake one another, the first wave weaving and the waves behind feeding to replenish their fiber. They move very quickly.|Vua Rapuung|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory I: Conquest]]''</ref>}}
'''Lav peq''', also called '''netting beetles''', were [[Yuuzhan Vong]] insects released by [[tsik vai]] to capture prey. These insects were used to capture and ensnare fugitives. They gave their name to the [[lav peq pattern]].
